verdict.rationale: OpenTofu documents its own encryption of state and plan files at rest. It integrates with KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP Cloud KMS, Azure Key Vault, OpenBao), and the encryption config can be supplied via the TF_ENCRYPTION environment variable instead of code. This protects sensitive values that land in deployment artifacts, but the evidence never shows how secrets are passed in or kept out of CLI output and logs. missing for 10: documented sensitive/secret input variable handling, redaction of secrets in plan/apply output and logs, a mechanism for injecting secrets without storing them (e.g. ephemeral values), independent hands-on corroboration
